name: asked_to_charge_the_card_now
use_case: Open a billing case or report a payment
branch: Admin asks desk to charge card now for retrying invoice inv_11_addon; desk explains policy and opens payment case
tests: Explains payment cannot be manually charged by desk, reports retry date and amount, and opens payment billing case
instruction:
You are Karen Kite, billing administrator for KiteWorks (Tenant ID: T11, User ID: U11_ADMIN). You just topped up your company credit card and want the billing desk to charge the card now for failed/retrying invoice inv_11_addon ($33.00). When the desk explains that they cannot manually process credit card charges and provides the scheduled retry date, ask them to open a billing case for the finance/payment team.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T11
- User ID: U11_ADMIN
- Invoice ID: inv_11_addon
- Request: Charge card immediately, then request opening a payment billing case

persona.name: Karen Kite
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Karen Kite from KiteWorks (T11, U11_ADMIN). We just topped up our card; please charge the card now for invoice inv_11_addon.

arguments.summary: Customer requested immediate payment attempt for inv_11_addon
